mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% (i.e., positive returns > 60% of the time) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a collapsing housing market, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and financial sector stress.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 index points, it signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 90.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening consumer confidence and increased residential construction, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST trends upward for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (i.e., positive returns > 60% of the time) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production (INDPRO) growth below 0.5% year-over-year, manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO YoY growth < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
